title: Vulnerability Management
description: Site/severity trending, SLA compliance, CISA KEV exposure, worst-devices hit list, and MTTR tracking against the vuln_findings core. Companion to Vuln-Analysis-Current.pbix, not a replacement.

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT site_label FROM dim_site ORDER BY site_label

options.content:
### How to read this dashboard

**Severity** is colored red (Critical) to orange (High) to amber (Medium) to yellow (Low) everywhere it appears as a category -- deliberately no green, since even a Low-severity finding is not good news. Green is reserved for genuinely positive signals: improving trend deltas and daily remediation counts.

**SLA Breach** -- a finding is a breach once its age (from first detected) exceeds its severity's threshold. Current thresholds are shown in the "Current SLA Policy" panel below -- these can change over time, so check that panel rather than assuming.

**CISA KEV** -- Known Exploited Vulnerabilities. CISA has *confirmed* this CVE is being actively exploited in the wild right now. Binary, reactive, and the single highest-priority signal here.

**EPSS** -- Exploit Prediction Scoring System (FIRST.org). A daily-updated probability (0-100%) a CVE will be exploited in the wild in the next 30 days. Predictive rather than confirmed -- the complement to KEV, not a replacement for it. "High EPSS, not yet KEV" findings are the ones most likely to become KEV-listed soon.

**Risk Score** (Worst Devices) -- a weighted composite per asset: severity counts plus a KEV bonus plus a remote/no-auth bonus. Higher is worse. A relative ranking tool, not an absolute unit.

**Priority Score** (Top Patches to Deploy) -- a weighted composite per patch/plugin: affected-asset count plus severity plus remote/no-auth plus KEV plus EPSS. Answers "which single fix closes the most, worst risk" -- not the same thing as raw finding count alone.

**Remote + No-Auth** -- exploitable over the network with no credentials required (CVSS Attack Vector: Network/Adjacent, Privileges Required: None). The subset of Critical/High findings actually reachable by an attacker starting from zero access.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Open Findings" FROM fact_vuln_findings_current WHERE site_label IN ($site)
SELECT count(*) AS "Critical + High" FROM fact_vuln_findings_current WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND severity IN ('critical','high')
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE sla_breach) / NULLIF(count(*),0), 1) AS "SLA Breach Rate" FROM fact_vuln_findings_current WHERE site_label IN ($site)
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_kev) / NULLIF(count(*),0), 1) AS "Active KEV %" FROM fact_vuln_findings_current WHERE site_label IN ($site)
SELECT count(*) AS "Remote+NoAuth Crit/High" FROM fact_vuln_findings_current WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND severity IN ('critical','high') AND is_remote_no_auth

SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, sum(remote_crit) AS "Remote Critical", sum(remote_high) AS "Remote High" FROM daily_site_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}' GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY time

SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, sum(crit) AS "Critical", sum(high) AS "High", sum(medium) AS "Medium", sum(low) AS "Low" FROM daily_site_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}' GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY time

panels.title: Net Change (Opened − Closed)
panels.description: Findings opened minus findings closed over the selected time range. Positive = backlog growing.

targets.rawSql:
WITH opened AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS n FROM vuln_findings
  WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND first_found::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
),
closed AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(sum(fixed_count),0) AS n FROM daily_mttr_metrics
  WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
)
SELECT (opened.n - closed.n)::int AS "Net Change" FROM opened, closed

WITH opened AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', first_found)::date AS d, count(*) AS n
  FROM vuln_findings
  WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND first_found::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
  GROUP BY 1
),
closed AS (
  SELECT snapshot_date AS d, sum(fixed_count) AS n
  FROM daily_mttr_metrics
  WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(o.d, c.d)::timestamp AS time, COALESCE(o.n, 0) AS "Opened", -COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS "Closed"
FROM opened o FULL OUTER JOIN closed c ON o.d = c.d
ORDER BY time
SELECT threshold_days AS "SLA (days)" FROM sla_policy WHERE severity = 'critical'
SELECT threshold_days AS "SLA (days)" FROM sla_policy WHERE severity = 'high'
SELECT threshold_days AS "SLA (days)" FROM sla_policy WHERE severity = 'medium'
SELECT threshold_days AS "SLA (days)" FROM sla_policy WHERE severity = 'low'

panels.title: SLA Breach by Site & Risk (latest snapshot)

targets.rawSql: SELECT site_label AS "Site", risk AS "Risk", total_vulns AS "Total", sla_breaches AS "Breaches", round(100.0 * sla_breaches / NULLIF(total_vulns,0), 1) AS "Breach Rate %" FROM daily_sla_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM daily_sla_metrics) ORDER BY "Breach Rate %" DESC

panels.title: SLA Breach Rate Trend by Risk Band

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, risk AS metric, round(100.0 * sum(sla_breaches) / NULLIF(sum(total_vulns),0), 1) AS value FROM daily_sla_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}' GROUP BY snapshot_date, risk ORDER BY time
SELECT sum(kev_open_total) AS "Open KEV" FROM daily_kev_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM daily_kev_metrics)
SELECT sum(kev_ransomware_total) AS "Ransomware-Flagged" FROM daily_kev_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM daily_kev_metrics)
SELECT sum(kev_past_due_total) AS "Past Due" FROM daily_kev_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM daily_kev_metrics)

SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, sum(kev_open_total) AS "Open KEV", sum(kev_ransomware_total) AS "Ransomware-Flagged" FROM daily_kev_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}' GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY time

panels.title: Open KEV Findings (by CVE, soonest due first)

targets.rawSql: SELECT kev_cve_id AS "CVE", mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY product_family) FILTER (WHERE product_family IS NOT NULL) AS "Application", round(max(cvss_score)::numeric,1) AS "CVSS", max(kev_due_date) AS "KEV Due", max(kev_ransomware_use) AS "Ransomware Use", count(*) AS "Findings", count(DISTINCT source_asset_id) AS "Assets", count(DISTINCT site_label) AS "Sites", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='critical') AS "Crit", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='high') AS "High", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='medium') AS "Med", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='low') AS "Low", round(max(age_days)::numeric,1) AS "Oldest (days)" FROM fact_vuln_findings_current WHERE has_kev AND site_label IN ($site) GROUP BY kev_cve_id ORDER BY "KEV Due" ASC NULLS LAST, "Crit" DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT sum(high_epss_non_kev_total) AS "High-EPSS Not Yet KEV" FROM daily_epss_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM daily_epss_metrics)

SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, avg(avg_epss) AS "Avg EPSS", max(max_epss) AS "Max EPSS" FROM daily_epss_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}' GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY time

WITH cve_findings AS (
  SELECT vf.id, vf.cvss_vector FROM vuln_findings vf
  WHERE vf.state IN ('OPEN','REOPENED')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vuln_finding_cves fc WHERE fc.finding_id = vf.id)
)
SELECT
  count(*) AS "CVE-Backed Open Findings",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE cvss_vector IS NOT NULL) AS "With CVSS Vector",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE cvss_vector IS NULL) AS "Missing Vector",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM nvd_cvss_cache WHERE found) AS "NVD: CVEs Found",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM nvd_cvss_cache WHERE NOT found) AS "NVD: Not Yet Scored"
FROM cve_findings;

panels.title: Likely Next (High EPSS, Not Yet KEV) - by CVE

targets.rawSql: SELECT epss_cve_id AS "CVE", mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY product_family) FILTER (WHERE product_family IS NOT NULL) AS "Application", round(max(cvss_score)::numeric,1) AS "CVSS", round((epss_score*100)::numeric,1) AS "EPSS %", round((epss_percentile*100)::numeric,1) AS "Percentile", count(*) AS "Findings", count(DISTINCT source_asset_id) AS "Assets", count(DISTINCT site_label) AS "Sites", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='critical') AS "Crit", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='high') AS "High", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='medium') AS "Med", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='low') AS "Low", count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_remote_no_auth) AS "Remote/No-Auth", round(max(age_days)::numeric,1) AS "Oldest (days)", ((count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='critical')*10 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='high')*5 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='medium')*2 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='low')*1) + ROUND((count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='critical')*10 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='high')*5 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='medium')*2 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='low')*1) * epss_score) + (count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_remote_no_auth) * 5))::int AS "Priority" FROM fact_vuln_findings_current WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND epss_score >= 0.5 AND NOT has_kev GROUP BY epss_cve_id, epss_score, epss_percentile ORDER BY "Priority" DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT hostname AS "Host", site_label AS "Site", asset_type AS "Type", open_critical AS "Crit", open_high AS "High", open_medium AS "Med", open_low AS "Low", open_kev_count AS "KEV", open_remote_no_auth AS "Remote/No-Auth", round(oldest_open_finding_age_days::numeric,1) AS "Oldest (days)", risk_score AS "Risk Score" FROM asset_risk_summary WHERE site_label IN ($site) ORDER BY risk_score DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top 10 Patches to Deploy (org-wide, not filtered by $site)

targets.rawSql: SELECT title AS "Patch / Check", product_family AS "Product Family", affected_assets AS "Assets", open_findings AS "Findings", crit AS "Crit", high AS "High", medium AS "Med", low AS "Low", remote_no_auth_count AS "Remote/No-Auth", CASE WHEN has_kev THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "KEV", round((COALESCE(max_epss,0)*100)::numeric,1) AS "Max EPSS %", priority_score AS "Priority" FROM patch_impact_summary ORDER BY priority_score DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, severity AS metric, avg(avg_remediation_days) AS value FROM daily_mttr_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}' GROUP BY snapshot_date, severity ORDER BY time

panels.title: SLA Compliance Rate by Severity (selected period)

targets.rawSql: SELECT severity AS "Severity", round(100.0 * sum(sla_compliant_count) / NULLIF(sum(fixed_count),0), 1) AS "SLA Compliance %" FROM daily_mttr_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}' GROUP BY severity ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

panels.title: Top Products by Open Findings (latest snapshot)

targets.rawSql: SELECT product AS "Product", vendor AS "Vendor", product_family AS "Family", sum(open_crit) AS "Crit", sum(open_high) AS "High", sum(open_medium) AS "Med", sum(open_low) AS "Low", sum(open_total) AS "Total" FROM daily_product_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM daily_product_metrics) GROUP BY product, vendor, product_family ORDER BY "Total" DESC LIMIT 15
